scene: 序场 · 小酒馆靠窗夜雨 · 双人隔小木桌对坐对视
prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, shot on iPhone, realistic handheld with subtle film grain, natural matte skin with visible pores and real texture, no waxy plastic over-smoothed skin and no glossy highlight sheen on the faces, the two people shown in <Picture 1> stay at the small wooden table by the rain-streaked tavern window at night, keeping their appearance, clothing, seating, and the plain unlabeled white ceramic bottle and two clear glasses between them. The camera holds a near-static handheld shot with slight breathing motion. The young woman (S1), an East Asian woman speaking Mandarin at a normal, slightly quick pace with no dead air between her words, keeps her eyes on her glass and hesitates for a moment before she opens her mouth and says: <d>[Chinese]我问你个事，你别急着否认。这几年，你有没有过……别人。</d> The young man (S2), an East Asian man, flinches slightly and answers plainly and without any pause: <d>[Chinese]没有。你怎么突然问这个。</d> She turns her face away and does not answer. The man (S2), his voice softer now and his gaze searching into her, continues immediately with no gap: <d>[Chinese]你是不是，宁可我有。</d> She picks up her glass and drinks it down in one swallow, pressing her feeling flat. Micro-expressions stay restrained and real, no exaggeration and no theatrical recitation, as if forcing calm over an urge to break. No subtitles, no caption bar, no lyric strip and no on-screen text of any kind are burned into the frame.

overall_soundscape: Steady rain taps against the window outside while low indoor room tone runs continuously underneath. The soft clink of a glass lifted and set back on the wooden table fills the pauses, keeping the ambience unbroken with no dead silence.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

checks: mode=I2VA: instruction line references <Picture 1> from [Shot 1] at 0.00s, single continuous two-person shot developing forward from the first frame per base-en.txt §3.1

minimal-prompt recipe: visuals/identity/props/realism carried by ref_image; H3 side adds only 'realistic handheld with subtle film grain' plus a measured de-wax clause (natural matte skin with visible pores / no waxy plastic over-smoothed skin / no glossy highlight sheen on faces) to kill H3's default gloss without stacking heavy visual vocabulary that would steal focus from lip-sync

dialogue inline (H3同期): both speakers use stable IDs (S1 苏晚 / S2 陈叙), <d>[Chinese]...</d> verbatim with original punctuation, no translation/rewrite
speech-rate lock: 'normal, slightly quick pace with no dead air', 'without any pause', 'continues immediately with no gap', final one-swallow drink — no slow delivery, no dead tail

performance layer fed as concrete actions not labels: hesitation before opening mouth, plain quick denial, face turned away, softer searching 'ningke wo you', one-gulp drink to press emotion flat; restraint / collapse-未遂 tone
anti-subtitle: explicit negative — no subtitles / caption bar / lyric strip / on-screen text burned into frame
continuous audio bed: rain + indoor room tone + glass clink fill pauses, no dead silence (bans dead-air)
compliance: unlabeled white ceramic bottle and unlabeled clear glasses, no brand/logo/text in frame
casting: S1/S2 explicitly locked East Asian / Mandarin
duration ~11s single shot, no timestamp on Shot 1, no cuts; vertical 9:16 carried by ref_image framing
